data_kind: real Qwen3-8B cached scores and activations
objective: min sum_fit_AP(raw_delta + delta_feature @ w)^2 + 0.01 ||w||^2; no pair intercept
constraint: For each fit C/F pair, abs(delta_feature @ w) <= tau * fit AP raw RMS
selection: Fixed tau grid, first dev CF RMS=0.20 crossing, root solve; only dev C/F RMS chooses tau; same procedure for N/U/S/50 random
calibration: Fit-only original natural nodes, logistic intercept; no effect on pair deltas

bootstrap.random_control: mean of 50 separate VR statistics, not an ensemble
bootstrap.interpretation: Source uncertainty conditional on fixed 50 random draws; random-draw distribution reported separately

metrics.probe_R2: Unconstrained saved AP ridge predictor on same feature family; distinct from bounded repair_R2
metrics.direction_degraded: raw correct label-signed evidence response >0 and corrected <=0
metrics.exceeds_fit_budget: Heldout CF abs correction difference exceeds chosen tau*fit_AP_RMS

test_policy: All dev-selected weights frozen. No test rescaling or budget selection. Full grid mapped to test descriptively only.
